name: New Horizons
description: Curated rules: three Orders (including targeted Focus Fire) and six magic schools with six ranked school skills. Existing hero spells are reclassified; Sorcery Magic Arrow remains a level 1 spell and now supports the saved Overcharge-ready direct-damage formula (base 20, power coefficient 20). The planned new spell roster, including Magic Missile, is not registered. Provisional coefficients, costs and flagged faction assignments. New games snapshot rules; legacy saves retain their original semantics. Generated by tools/update-new-horizons-module.py from canonical config/newHorizons*.json data. Separate future development candidate: provisional class primary profiles, scaled hero formulas and skill-related extra growth. Not the frozen commands/schools release or full mastery/tier implementation. Separate capability candidate: non-destructive soft leadership capacity and skill-trained ballista scaling. No mastery or creature-category implementation. Separate future Artillery mastery candidate: one permanent extra choice after a level gained with prior Expert Artillery. Not secondary rank four or completion of other mastery families, creature tiers or new spell effects. Includes the canonical 31-Skill, ten-perk registry as planned data; perk selection and effects require the corresponding runtime systems. Includes independently authored quick-save/load buttons and creature ability icons; landscape presentation only.

new-horizons:diplomacy.name: Diplomacy
new-horizons:diplomacy.description: Diplomacy turns neutral-creature interaction into a deterministic negotiation system rather than a save-scummable random roll. Scripted or explicitly hostile encounters may be marked ineligible.

basic.description: An eligible neutral stack with Army Value no greater than 25% of the hero's current army may offer to join for its normal recruitment gold cost.

effect.description: An eligible neutral stack with Army Value no greater than 25% of the hero's current army may offer to join for its normal recruitment gold cost.

advanced.description: The deterministic joining threshold becomes 50% of the hero's Army Value.

effect.description: The deterministic joining threshold becomes 50% of the hero's Army Value.

expert.description: The deterministic joining threshold becomes 75% of the hero's Army Value.

effect.description: The deterministic joining threshold becomes 75% of the hero's Army Value.

perks.name: Negotiator
perks.description: Increase the Diplomacy joining threshold by 15 percentage points.

effect.description: Increase the Diplomacy joining threshold by 15 percentage points.

perks.name: Peacemaker
perks.description: Once per week, the hero may pass through one eligible neutral stack without fighting it; the neutral stack remains on the map.

effect.description: Once per week, the hero may pass through one eligible neutral stack without fighting it; the neutral stack remains on the map.

perks.name: Envoy
perks.description: From up to 5 hexes away, reveal whether a visible neutral stack is willing to negotiate and the gold required if it joins.

effect.description: From up to 5 hexes away, reveal whether a visible neutral stack is willing to negotiate and the gold required if it joins.

perks.name: Mercenary Captain
perks.description: Creatures recruited through Diplomacy gain +1 Morale for their first three combats under this hero.

effect.description: Creatures recruited through Diplomacy gain +1 Morale for their first three combats under this hero.

perks.name: Common Cause
perks.description: Neutral creatures of the hero's faction count as half their normal Army Value when checking the Diplomacy threshold.

effect.description: Neutral creatures of the hero's faction count as half their normal Army Value when checking the Diplomacy threshold.

perks.name: Tribute
perks.description: Once per week, an eligible neutral stack that will not join may instead accept gold equal to its normal recruitment value and leave the map without combat.

effect.description: Once per week, an eligible neutral stack that will not join may instead accept gold equal to its normal recruitment value and leave the map without combat.

perks.name: Loyal Mercenaries
perks.description: Creatures recruited through Diplomacy do not contribute to mixed-faction Morale penalties while commanded by this hero.

effect.description: Creatures recruited through Diplomacy do not contribute to mixed-faction Morale penalties while commanded by this hero.

perks.name: Recruitment Pact
perks.description: After successfully recruiting a neutral stack, the next neutral stack contacted within 7 days is treated as 15% lower Army Value for the joining threshold.

effect.description: After successfully recruiting a neutral stack, the next neutral stack contacted within 7 days is treated as 15% lower Army Value for the joining threshold.

perks.name: Grand Diplomat
perks.description: Increase the Diplomacy joining threshold by a further 25 percentage points, to a maximum of 100% of the hero's Army Value.

effect.description: Increase the Diplomacy joining threshold by a further 25 percentage points, to a maximum of 100% of the hero's Army Value.

perks.name: Legendary Reputation
perks.description: Once per calendar month, the first eligible neutral stack that qualifies to join through Diplomacy joins without a gold payment.

effect.description: Once per calendar month, the first eligible neutral stack that qualifies to join through Diplomacy joins without a gold payment.

new-horizons:estates.name: Estates
new-horizons:estates.description: Estates is the hero's economic specialization: rents, land management, mine exploitation, markets, and treasury finance. Its values are deliberately discrete where practical.

basic.description: The kingdom receives +125 Gold per day while the hero is active.

effect.description: The kingdom receives +125 Gold per day while the hero is active.

advanced.description: Daily income from Estates increases to +250 Gold.

effect.description: Daily income from Estates increases to +250 Gold.

expert.description: Daily income from Estates increases to +500 Gold.

effect.description: Daily income from Estates increases to +500 Gold.

perks.name: Tax Collector
perks.description: Gain +50 Gold per day for each owned town, capped at +500 Gold per day from this perk.

effect.description: Gain +50 Gold per day for each owned town, capped at +500 Gold per day from this perk.

perks.name: Land Surveyor
perks.description: The first mine captured by this hero each week immediately produces three days of its normal output.

effect.description: The first mine captured by this hero each week immediately produces three days of its normal output.

perks.name: Prospector
perks.description: Once per week when visiting an owned mine, gain +2 of its common resource or +1 of its rare resource immediately.

effect.description: Once per week when visiting an owned mine, gain +2 of its common resource or +1 of its rare resource immediately.

perks.name: Merchant Prince
perks.description: While this hero is in a town, that town's Marketplace exchange rates behave as if the kingdom owned two additional Marketplaces.

effect.description: While this hero is in a town, that town's Marketplace exchange rates behave as if the kingdom owned two additional Marketplaces.

perks.name: Steward
perks.description: If the hero ends the day in an owned town, that town produces +250 Gold on the next day.

effect.description: If the hero ends the day in an owned town, that town produces +250 Gold on the next day.

perks.name: Investor
perks.description: Once per week, invest 1,000 Gold from the treasury; exactly 7 days later the treasury receives 1,250 Gold.

effect.description: Once per week, invest 1,000 Gold from the treasury; exactly 7 days later the treasury receives 1,250 Gold.

perks.name: Resource Broker
perks.description: Once per week at a Marketplace, exchange exactly 5 Wood or 5 Ore for 1 chosen rare resource, independent of ordinary market rates.

effect.description: Once per week at a Marketplace, exchange exactly 5 Wood or 5 Ore for 1 chosen rare resource, independent of ordinary market rates.

perks.name: Estate Network
perks.description: At the start of each week, gain +1 Wood and +1 Ore for every three owned towns, rounded down, minimum 1 if at least one town is owned.

effect.description: At the start of each week, gain +1 Wood and +1 Ore for every three owned towns, rounded down, minimum 1 if at least one town is owned.

perks.name: Financier
perks.description: At the start of each week, gain 1% of the current Gold treasury as interest, capped at 1,000 Gold.

effect.description: At the start of each week, gain 1% of the current Gold treasury as interest, capped at 1,000 Gold.

perks.name: Magnate
perks.description: At the start of each week, designate one owned town the hero has visited during the previous week; that town produces +500 Gold per day for the next 7 days.

effect.description: At the start of each week, designate one owned town the hero has visited during the previous week; that town produces +500 Gold per day for the next 7 days.

new-horizons:learning.name: Learning
new-horizons:learning.description: Learning covers experience, teaching, study, spell exchange, and the acquisition of knowledge from the world. Scholar and Eagle Eye are absorbed as perks. New Horizons has no ordinary Mage Guild Spell Research mechanic.

basic.description: Experience gained by the hero increases by 10%.

effect.description: Experience gained by the hero increases by 10%.

advanced.description: Experience gained increases by 20%.

effect.description: Experience gained increases by 20%.

expert.description: Experience gained increases by 30%.

effect.description: Experience gained increases by 30%.

perks.name: Scholar
perks.description: When two allied heroes meet, each may teach the other one spell that the recipient could legally learn. Once per hero pair per week.

effect.description: When two allied heroes meet, each may teach the other one spell that the recipient could legally learn. Once per hero pair per week.

perks.name: Eagle Eye
perks.description: After combat, permanently learn one Level 1-3 spell cast by the enemy hero during that combat if this hero could legally learn it.

effect.description: After combat, permanently learn one Level 1-3 spell cast by the enemy hero during that combat if this hero could legally learn it.

perks.name: Historian
perks.description: Adventure-map objects whose primary reward is Experience grant 50% more Experience.

effect.description: Adventure-map objects whose primary reward is Experience grant 50% more Experience.

perks.name: Mentor
perks.description: Once per week when meeting a lower-level allied hero, grant that hero Experience equal to 250 times the mentor's level.

effect.description: Once per week when meeting a lower-level allied hero, grant that hero Experience equal to 250 times the mentor's level.

perks.name: Academic Study
perks.description: The first time the hero visits each town, gain 250 Experience for each Mage Guild level already constructed in that town.

effect.description: The first time the hero visits each town, gain 250 Experience for each Mage Guild level already constructed in that town.

perks.name: Quick Study
perks.description: Once every five hero levels, reroll the current level-up choices once.

effect.description: Once every five hero levels, reroll the current level-up choices once.

perks.name: Field Study
perks.description: Gain +25% additional Experience from defeating enemy heroes or wandering armies whose Army Value exceeded your army's at battle start.

effect.description: Gain +25% additional Experience from defeating enemy heroes or wandering armies whose Army Value exceeded your army's at battle start.

perks.name: Archivist
perks.description: When the hero acquires a spell scroll, permanently learn its spell immediately if legally eligible.

effect.description: When the hero acquires a spell scroll, permanently learn its spell immediately if legally eligible.

perks.name: Sage
perks.description: Once per town, visiting its Mage Guild allows the hero to choose and learn one eligible spell from the guild's built levels and available schools.

effect.description: Once per town, visiting its Mage Guild allows the hero to choose and learn one eligible spell from the guild's built levels and available schools.

perks.name: Master Teacher
perks.description: Mentor may be used on two different allied heroes per week and grants 500 times the mentor's level in Experience to each.

effect.description: Mentor may be used on two different allied heroes per week and grants 500 times the mentor's level in Experience to each.

new-horizons:luck.name: Luck
new-horizons:luck.description: Luck governs favorable and unfavorable chance in combat. The exact -10 to +10 trigger curve is defined by the Luck/Morale system; this Skill shifts the hero's army toward favorable outcomes.

basic.description: Friendly army receives +1 Luck.

effect.description: Friendly army receives +1 Luck.

advanced.description: Friendly army receives +2 Luck total.

effect.description: Friendly army receives +2 Luck total.

expert.description: Friendly army receives +3 Luck total.

effect.description: Friendly army receives +3 Luck total.

perks.name: Opportunist
perks.description: After a positive Luck trigger on an attack, the stack may move up to 2 hexes using remaining movement. It gains no additional attack.

effect.description: After a positive Luck trigger on an attack, the stack may move up to 2 hexes using remaining movement. It gains no additional attack.

perks.name: Second Chance
perks.description: The first negative Luck trigger against the army each combat is ignored.

effect.description: The first negative Luck trigger against the army each combat is ignored.

perks.name: Lucky Aim
perks.description: A ranged attack that triggers positive Luck ignores 25% of the target's Creature Defense.

effect.description: A ranged attack that triggers positive Luck ignores 25% of the target's Creature Defense.

perks.name: Fortune's Favor
perks.description: Positive Lucky Strike damage multipliers increase by +0.25x.

effect.description: Positive Lucky Strike damage multipliers increase by +0.25x.

perks.name: Serendipity
perks.description: If no friendly positive Luck trigger occurred during the previous round, the first friendly attack of the new round receives +2 Luck for that attack.

effect.description: If no friendly positive Luck trigger occurred during the previous round, the first friendly attack of the new round receives +2 Luck for that attack.

perks.name: Lucky Recovery
perks.description: When a melee attack triggers positive Luck, surviving creatures in the attacker recover HP equal to 10% of actual damage dealt.

effect.description: When a melee attack triggers positive Luck, surviving creatures in the attacker recover HP equal to 10% of actual damage dealt.

perks.name: Gambler
perks.description: Once per round before attacking, declare a wager: gain +3 Luck for that attack; if positive Luck does not trigger, suffer -2 Luck until the stack's next activation.

effect.description: Once per round before attacking, declare a wager: gain +3 Luck for that attack; if positive Luck does not trigger, suffer -2 Luck until the stack's next activation.

perks.name: Chain of Fortune
perks.description: Once per round after a friendly positive Luck trigger, the next friendly stack to attack gains +1 Luck for that attack.

effect.description: Once per round after a friendly positive Luck trigger, the next friendly stack to attack gains +1 Luck for that attack.

perks.name: Twist of Fate
perks.description: Once per combat, force one random combat outcome affecting your army to be rerolled. Deterministic effects cannot be rerolled.

effect.description: Once per combat, force one random combat outcome affecting your army to be rerolled. Deterministic effects cannot be rerolled.

perks.name: Perfect Fortune
perks.description: Once per combat before damage is calculated, declare one eligible attack to trigger positive Luck automatically.

effect.description: Once per combat before damage is calculated, declare one eligible attack to trigger positive Luck automatically.

new-horizons:divineMandate.name: Divine Mandate
new-horizons:divineMandate.description: Faction-locked Skill. Castle unites sacred intervention and military command. Divine Mandate creates a precise exception to the normal Spell-or-Order choice without introducing a second action currency.

basic.description: Once per combat, when the hero uses the Hero Action to cast a Light Spell, immediately issue one Order; or after using the Hero Action to issue an Order, immediately cast one Light Spell.

effect.description: Once per combat, when the hero uses the Hero Action to cast a Light Spell, immediately issue one Order; or after using the Hero Action to issue an Order, immediately cast one Light Spell.

advanced.description: Divine Mandate may be used twice per combat.

effect.description: Divine Mandate may be used twice per combat.

expert.description: Divine Mandate may be used three times per combat.

effect.description: Divine Mandate may be used three times per combat.

perks.name: Sacred Command
perks.description: An Order issued through Divine Mandate gains +10 percentage points of efficiency on its attribute-derived components.

effect.description: An Order issued through Divine Mandate gains +10 percentage points of efficiency on its attribute-derived components.

perks.name: Consecrated Casting
perks.description: A Light Spell cast through Divine Mandate gains +10% to its Spell Power-derived numerical component.

effect.description: A Light Spell cast through Divine Mandate gains +10% to its Spell Power-derived numerical component.

perks.name: Shared Purpose
perks.description: If the paired Light Spell and Order both affect the same friendly stack, that stack gains +1 Morale until its next activation.

effect.description: If the paired Light Spell and Order both affect the same friendly stack, that stack gains +1 Morale until its next activation.

perks.name: Chaplain's Reserve
perks.description: After the first Divine Mandate sequence each combat resolves, recover 3 Mana.

effect.description: After the first Divine Mandate sequence each combat resolves, recover 3 Mana.

perks.name: Divine Discipline
perks.description: An Order issued through Divine Mandate that would normally end at the end of the round remains on affected friendly stacks through their next Creature Activation.

effect.description: An Order issued through Divine Mandate that would normally end at the end of the round remains on affected friendly stacks through their next Creature Activation.

perks.name: Purifying Mandate
perks.description: When a Light Spell cast through Divine Mandate removes a negative magical effect, it also removes one physical affliction from that target if present.

effect.description: When a Light Spell cast through Divine Mandate removes a negative magical effect, it also removes one physical affliction from that target if present.

perks.name: Knightly Sequence
perks.description: If the Order is performed first, the paired Light Spell costs 2 less Mana; if the Light Spell is performed first, the paired Order gains +5 additional percentage points of efficiency.

effect.description: If the Order is performed first, the paired Light Spell costs 2 less Mana; if the Light Spell is performed first, the paired Order gains +5 additional percentage points of efficiency.

perks.name: Royal Standard
perks.description: Friendly stacks affected by an Order issued through Divine Mandate treat negative Morale as 0 for that Order's duration.

effect.description: Friendly stacks affected by an Order issued through Divine Mandate treat negative Morale as 0 for that Order's duration.

perks.name: Mandate of Heaven
perks.description: Once per combat, one Divine Mandate sequence does not consume a Divine Mandate use.

effect.description: Once per combat, one Divine Mandate sequence does not consume a Divine Mandate use.

perks.name: Crown and Altar
perks.description: If the paired Light Spell and Order both affect the same friendly stack, both their rating-derived numerical components are increased by 20%.

effect.description: If the paired Light Spell and Order both affect the same friendly stack, both their rating-derived numerical components are increased by 20%.

new-horizons:sylvanLuck.name: Sylvan Luck
new-horizons:sylvanLuck.description: Faction-locked Skill. Rampart turns fortune into a faction identity. Sylvan Luck increases both the frequency and the payoff of favorable Luck while keeping the universal Luck system intact.

basic.description: +1 Luck. Lucky Strike damage multiplier becomes 2.25x.

effect.description: +1 Luck. Lucky Strike damage multiplier becomes 2.25x.

advanced.description: +2 Luck total. Lucky Strike multiplier becomes 2.60x.

effect.description: +2 Luck total. Lucky Strike multiplier becomes 2.60x.

expert.description: +3 Luck total. Lucky Strike multiplier becomes 3.00x.

effect.description: +3 Luck total. Lucky Strike multiplier becomes 3.00x.

perks.name: Elven Precision
perks.description: Lucky ranged attacks ignore 25% Creature Defense.

effect.description: Lucky ranged attacks ignore 25% Creature Defense.

perks.name: Forest's Favor
perks.description: The first positive Luck trigger for each friendly stack in a combat grants +2 Speed for the remainder of that activation.

effect.description: The first positive Luck trigger for each friendly stack in a combat grants +2 Speed for the remainder of that activation.

perks.name: Serendipity
perks.description: Until a friendly stack has triggered positive Luck once in the current combat, it counts as having +1 additional Luck for trigger chance only.

effect.description: Until a friendly stack has triggered positive Luck once in the current combat, it counts as having +1 additional Luck for trigger chance only.

perks.name: Lucky Recovery
perks.description: A melee Lucky Strike restores surviving creatures for 10% of actual damage dealt.

effect.description: A melee Lucky Strike restores surviving creatures for 10% of actual damage dealt.

perks.name: Shared Fortune
perks.description: After a friendly stack triggers positive Luck, adjacent friendly stacks gain +1 Luck until their next activation.

effect.description: After a friendly stack triggers positive Luck, adjacent friendly stacks gain +1 Luck until their next activation.

perks.name: Nature's Providence
perks.description: The first negative Luck trigger against the army each round is ignored.

effect.description: The first negative Luck trigger against the army each round is ignored.

perks.name: Fortunate Aim
perks.description: Friendly shooters gain +1 Luck when attacking the target designated by Focus Fire!.

effect.description: Friendly shooters gain +1 Luck when attacking the target designated by Focus Fire!.

perks.name: Wild Chance
perks.description: Temporary creatures summoned by Nature spells inherit the hero's Sylvan Luck bonus and Lucky Strike multiplier.

effect.description: Temporary creatures summoned by Nature spells inherit the hero's Sylvan Luck bonus and Lucky Strike multiplier.

perks.name: Perfect Moment
perks.description: Once per combat, declare one eligible attack to trigger positive Luck automatically.

effect.description: Once per combat, declare one eligible attack to trigger positive Luck automatically.

perks.name: Cascading Fortune
perks.description: When a Lucky Strike destroys an enemy stack, the next friendly stack to act gains +3 Luck for its activation.

effect.description: When a Lucky Strike destroys an enemy stack, the next friendly stack to act gains +3 Luck for its activation.

new-horizons:metamagic.name: Metamagic
new-horizons:metamagic.description: Faction-locked Skill. Tower specializes in manipulating the act of spellcasting itself. Metamagic permits a second spell after a normal spell cast, with a limited number of uses per combat.

basic.description: Once per combat, after using the Hero Action to cast a Spell, immediately cast one additional Spell.

effect.description: Once per combat, after using the Hero Action to cast a Spell, immediately cast one additional Spell.

advanced.description: Metamagic may be used twice per combat.

effect.description: Metamagic may be used twice per combat.

expert.description: Metamagic may be used three times per combat.

effect.description: Metamagic may be used three times per combat.

perks.name: Spell Sequencing
perks.description: If the additional Spell is from a different school than the first, it gains +15% to its Spell Power-derived numerical component.

effect.description: If the additional Spell is from a different school than the first, it gains +15% to its Spell Power-derived numerical component.

perks.name: Arcane Economy
perks.description: The additional Spell costs 2 less Mana, to a minimum of 1.

effect.description: The additional Spell costs 2 less Mana, to a minimum of 1.

perks.name: Focused Pairing
perks.description: If both spells target the same stack, the additional hostile spell ignores 20% of that target's Magical Damage Reduction.

effect.description: If both spells target the same stack, the additional hostile spell ignores 20% of that target's Magical Damage Reduction.

perks.name: Countersequence
perks.description: If the additional Spell is Counterspell, its eventual counter cost uses 1.75 times the enemy spell's listed Mana cost, rounded up.

effect.description: If the additional Spell is Counterspell, its eventual counter cost uses 1.75 times the enemy spell's listed Mana cost, rounded up.

perks.name: Echoed Duration
perks.description: A temporary effect created by the additional Spell lasts 1 additional round.

effect.description: A temporary effect created by the additional Spell lasts 1 additional round.

perks.name: Split Focus
perks.description: If the additional Spell targets a different stack from the first, it gains +10% to its Spell Power-derived component.

effect.description: If the additional Spell targets a different stack from the first, it gains +10% to its Spell Power-derived component.

perks.name: Formula Reserve
perks.description: After the first Metamagic sequence each combat resolves, recover 3 Mana.

effect.description: After the first Metamagic sequence each combat resolves, recover 3 Mana.

perks.name: Spell Buffer
perks.description: If the first spell in a Metamagic sequence is negated by Counterspell, the additional Spell cannot be Counterspelled by that same armed Counterspell.

effect.description: If the first spell in a Metamagic sequence is negated by Counterspell, the additional Spell cannot be Counterspelled by that same armed Counterspell.

perks.name: Grand Metamagic
perks.description: Once per combat, one Metamagic use permits two additional Spells instead of one. Neither additional Spell can trigger further additional casting.

effect.description: Once per combat, one Metamagic use permits two additional Spells instead of one. Neither additional Spell can trigger further additional casting.

perks.name: Perfect Sequence
perks.description: If all spells in a Metamagic sequence are different spells, each additional Spell gains +20% to its Spell Power-derived numerical component.

effect.description: If all spells in a Metamagic sequence are different spells, each additional Spell gains +20% to its Spell Power-derived numerical component.

new-horizons:shroudOfMalassa.name: Shroud of Malassa
new-horizons:shroudOfMalassa.description: Faction-locked Skill. Dungeon warfare is positional predation. The Shroud lets friendly stacks pass through occupied hexes while moving and rewards attacks delivered from distinct sides and exposed positions.

basic.description: Friendly stacks gain Ghost Walk: they may move through occupied creature hexes but may not end movement on an occupied hex. Flanking melee attacks deal +25% damage.

effect.description: Friendly stacks gain Ghost Walk: they may move through occupied creature hexes but may not end movement on an occupied hex. Flanking melee attacks deal +25% damage.

advanced.description: Ghost Walk remains active. Flanking melee bonus becomes +40%.

effect.description: Ghost Walk remains active. Flanking melee bonus becomes +40%.

expert.description: Ghost Walk remains active. Flanking melee bonus becomes +60%, and flanking melee attacks deny normal retaliation.

effect.description: Ghost Walk remains active. Flanking melee bonus becomes +60%, and flanking melee attacks deny normal retaliation.

perks.name: Veiled Movement
perks.description: Ghost Walk movement does not trigger explicitly movement-based reaction attacks.

effect.description: Ghost Walk movement does not trigger explicitly movement-based reaction attacks.

perks.name: Backstab
perks.description: A melee attack from the target's rear-facing side gains an additional +15% damage.

effect.description: A melee attack from the target's rear-facing side gains an additional +15% damage.

perks.name: Ambusher
perks.description: The first flanking attack made by each friendly stack in a combat deals +20% damage.

effect.description: The first flanking attack made by each friendly stack in a combat deals +20% damage.

perks.name: Shadow Assault
perks.description: The first flanking attack against each enemy stack ignores 25% Creature Defense.

effect.description: The first flanking attack against each enemy stack ignores 25% Creature Defense.

perks.name: No Escape
perks.description: After suffering a flanking melee attack, the target loses 2 Speed until its next activation.

effect.description: After suffering a flanking melee attack, the target loses 2 Speed until its next activation.

perks.name: Evasive Shroud
perks.description: After making a flanking attack, the attacker receives 15% physical damage reduction until its next activation.

effect.description: After making a flanking attack, the attacker receives 15% physical damage reduction until its next activation.

perks.name: Deep Flank
perks.description: Friendly ranged attacks against a target currently attacked from at least two distinct melee sides gain half the Shroud's current flanking damage bonus.

effect.description: Friendly ranged attacks against a target currently attacked from at least two distinct melee sides gain half the Shroud's current flanking damage bonus.

perks.name: Night Prowler
perks.description: A stack that uses Ghost Walk to pass through an enemy stack's occupied hexes gains +10% damage on its next attack that activation.

effect.description: A stack that uses Ghost Walk to pass through an enemy stack's occupied hexes gains +10% damage on its next attack that activation.

perks.name: Encircled Doom
perks.description: Each additional distinct melee attack side beyond the first adds +10% damage to the Shroud flanking attack.

effect.description: Each additional distinct melee attack side beyond the first adds +10% damage to the Shroud flanking attack.

perks.name: Vanish
perks.description: After destroying an enemy with a flanking melee attack, the attacker may move up to half its Speed. It gains no additional attack.

effect.description: After destroying an enemy with a flanking melee attack, the attacker may move up to half its Speed. It gains no additional attack.

new-horizons:demonicGating.name: Demonic Gating
new-horizons:demonicGating.description: Faction-locked Skill. Inferno heroes may bring actual reserve troops onto the battlefield through gates. Gating uses a Demonic Reserve of owned Inferno creatures outside the seven active combat slots; creatures are not created for free.

basic.description: A friendly Inferno stack may spend its Creature Activation to open a Gate on a legal empty hex within 3 hexes. At the start of the next round, one Core stack from the Demonic Reserve arrives there.

effect.description: A friendly Inferno stack may spend its Creature Activation to open a Gate on a legal empty hex within 3 hexes. At the start of the next round, one Core stack from the Demonic Reserve arrives there.

advanced.description: Gating may bring Core or Elite reserve stacks.

effect.description: Gating may bring Core or Elite reserve stacks.

expert.description: Gating may bring Core, Elite, or Champion reserve stacks.

effect.description: Gating may bring Core, Elite, or Champion reserve stacks.

perks.name: Swift Gate
perks.description: A gated stack arrives at the end of the current round instead of the start of the next round.

effect.description: A gated stack arrives at the end of the current round instead of the start of the next round.

perks.name: Wide Gate
perks.description: Gate placement range increases from 3 to 5 hexes from the gating stack.

effect.description: Gate placement range increases from 3 to 5 hexes from the gating stack.

perks.name: Hellfire Arrival
perks.description: When a gated stack arrives, adjacent enemy stacks suffer Fire damage equal to 15% of the gated stack's current aggregate HP, divided evenly among them.

effect.description: When a gated stack arrives, adjacent enemy stacks suffer Fire damage equal to 15% of the gated stack's current aggregate HP, divided evenly among them.

perks.name: Reinforced Gate
perks.description: A gated stack gains temporary HP equal to 20% of its current aggregate HP until combat ends.

effect.description: A gated stack gains temporary HP equal to 20% of its current aggregate HP until combat ends.

perks.name: Mobile Gate
perks.description: A stack may move up to half its Speed before using its activation to Gate.

effect.description: A stack may move up to half its Speed before using its activation to Gate.

perks.name: Infernal Beacon
perks.description: If the Gate is placed adjacent to another friendly Inferno stack, the gated stack gains +2 Initiative during its first round on the battlefield.

effect.description: If the Gate is placed adjacent to another friendly Inferno stack, the gated stack gains +2 Initiative during its first round on the battlefield.

perks.name: Chain Gate
perks.description: After a gated stack destroys an enemy stack, the next Gate opened during that combat resolves one timing step sooner.

effect.description: After a gated stack destroys an enemy stack, the next Gate opened during that combat resolves one timing step sooner.

perks.name: Reserve Discipline
perks.description: Gated stacks treat negative Morale as 0 during the round in which they arrive.

effect.description: Gated stacks treat negative Morale as 0 during the round in which they arrive.

perks.name: Master Gate
perks.description: Once per combat, one friendly Inferno stack may open a Gate after completing its normal Creature Activation instead of spending the activation on Gating.

effect.description: Once per combat, one friendly Inferno stack may open a Gate after completing its normal Creature Activation instead of spending the activation on Gating.

perks.name: Endless Legion
perks.description: After a victorious combat, 50% of casualties suffered specifically by gated Core and Elite reserve stacks are restored to the Demonic Reserve, rounded down.

effect.description: After a victorious combat, 50% of casualties suffered specifically by gated Core and Elite reserve stacks are restored to the Demonic Reserve, rounded down.

new-horizons:necromancy.name: Necromancy
new-horizons:necromancy.description: Faction-locked Skill. Necromancy converts eligible enemy casualties into permanent Undead after victory. It creates strategic army growth without consuming the hero's Hero Action in combat.

basic.description: After victory, raise Skeletons equal to 10% of eligible living enemy creature casualties, rounded down.

effect.description: After victory, raise Skeletons equal to 10% of eligible living enemy creature casualties, rounded down.

advanced.description: Raise Skeletons equal to 20% of eligible casualties.

effect.description: Raise Skeletons equal to 20% of eligible casualties.

expert.description: Raise Skeletons equal to 30% of eligible casualties.

effect.description: Raise Skeletons equal to 30% of eligible casualties.

perks.name: Bone Collector
perks.description: Necromancy raises an additional +5 percentage points of eligible casualties as Skeletons.

effect.description: Necromancy raises an additional +5 percentage points of eligible casualties as Skeletons.

perks.name: Corpse Preservation
perks.description: Casualties caused by ordinary magical damage remain eligible for Necromancy unless an effect explicitly destroys or invalidates remains.

effect.description: Casualties caused by ordinary magical damage remain eligible for Necromancy unless an effect explicitly destroys or invalidates remains.

perks.name: Dark Conversion
perks.description: When resolving Necromancy, the player may convert every 3 Skeletons that would be raised into 1 Zombie instead.

effect.description: When resolving Necromancy, the player may convert every 3 Skeletons that would be raised into 1 Zombie instead.

perks.name: Black Harvest
perks.description: After Necromancy raises at least 10 creatures, recover 1 Mana per 10 creatures raised, up to 10 Mana.

effect.description: After Necromancy raises at least 10 creatures, recover 1 Mana per 10 creatures raised, up to 10 Mana.

perks.name: Soul Harvester
perks.description: The player may convert every 6 Skeletons that would be raised into 1 Wight or equivalent Necropolis Elite defined by the faction roster.

effect.description: The player may convert every 6 Skeletons that would be raised into 1 Wight or equivalent Necropolis Elite defined by the faction roster.

perks.name: Death Lord
perks.description: Construct and Elemental casualties become eligible at 25% of the normal Necromancy conversion rate.

effect.description: Construct and Elemental casualties become eligible at 25% of the normal Necromancy conversion rate.

perks.name: Grave Knowledge
perks.description: When defeating Undead enemies, 20% of their eligible casualties may be reclaimed as Skeletons even though they are not living.

effect.description: When defeating Undead enemies, 20% of their eligible casualties may be reclaimed as Skeletons even though they are not living.

perks.name: Ossuary
perks.description: If the hero has no legal army slot for raised creatures, they are sent to the nearest owned Necropolis town instead of being lost.

effect.description: If the hero has no legal army slot for raised creatures, they are sent to the nearest owned Necropolis town instead of being lost.

perks.name: Master of Bones
perks.description: Skeletons raised by Necromancy are raised as their upgraded form when the appropriate Necropolis upgrade is available to the player.

effect.description: Skeletons raised by Necromancy are raised as their upgraded form when the appropriate Necropolis upgrade is available to the player.

perks.name: Lord of the Dead
perks.description: After defeating an army containing at least one Champion-tier living creature, Necromancy may replace 12 Skeletons from its result with 1 faction-defined high-tier Undead, once per combat.

effect.description: After defeating an army containing at least one Champion-tier living creature, Necromancy may replace 12 Skeletons from its result with 1 faction-defined high-tier Undead, once per combat.

new-horizons:bloodrage.name: Bloodrage
new-horizons:bloodrage.description: Faction-locked Skill. Stronghold gains momentum from destruction. Bloodrage is a battle-long damage state that rises whenever a non-summoned stack on either side is destroyed.

basic.description: Each non-summoned stack destroyed grants surviving friendly stacks +5% damage, cumulative to +20%.

effect.description: Each non-summoned stack destroyed grants surviving friendly stacks +5% damage, cumulative to +20%.

advanced.description: Each destruction grants +8% damage, cumulative to +40%.

effect.description: Each destruction grants +8% damage, cumulative to +40%.

expert.description: Each destruction grants +12% damage, cumulative to +60%.

effect.description: Each destruction grants +12% damage, cumulative to +60%.

perks.name: First Blood
perks.description: The first qualifying stack destroyed in each combat grants two Bloodrage increments instead of one.

effect.description: The first qualifying stack destroyed in each combat grants two Bloodrage increments instead of one.

perks.name: Blood Scent
perks.description: When attacking an enemy below 50% maximum HP, treat Bloodrage as one increment higher for that attack.

effect.description: When attacking an enemy below 50% maximum HP, treat Bloodrage as one increment higher for that attack.

perks.name: War Drums
perks.description: Begin each combat with one Bloodrage increment already active.

effect.description: Begin each combat with one Bloodrage increment already active.

perks.name: Rage Through Pain
perks.description: The first time a friendly stack falls below 50% maximum HP, that stack gains one personal Bloodrage increment for the rest of combat.

effect.description: The first time a friendly stack falls below 50% maximum HP, that stack gains one personal Bloodrage increment for the rest of combat.

perks.name: Slayer
perks.description: Destroying an Elite or Champion stack grants two Bloodrage increments.

effect.description: Destroying an Elite or Champion stack grants two Bloodrage increments.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: At half of the current Bloodrage cap or higher, friendly stacks gain +1 Speed.

effect.description: At half of the current Bloodrage cap or higher, friendly stacks gain +1 Speed.

perks.name: Berserker
perks.description: At half of the current Bloodrage cap or higher, friendly stacks gain one additional retaliation.

effect.description: At half of the current Bloodrage cap or higher, friendly stacks gain one additional retaliation.

perks.name: Fury Unbound
perks.description: While at least one Bloodrage increment is active, friendly stacks treat negative Morale as 0.

effect.description: While at least one Bloodrage increment is active, friendly stacks treat negative Morale as 0.

perks.name: Avatar of Rage
perks.description: At maximum Bloodrage, friendly creature attacks ignore 25% Creature Defense.

effect.description: At maximum Bloodrage, friendly creature attacks ignore 25% Creature Defense.

perks.name: Endless Bloodshed
perks.description: Increase Bloodrage's maximum damage cap by 20 percentage points.

effect.description: Increase Bloodrage's maximum damage cap by 20 percentage points.

new-horizons:bulwarkOfTheMire.name: Bulwark of the Mire
new-horizons:bulwarkOfTheMire.description: Faction-locked Skill. Fortress transforms the universal Defend action into a faction weapon. Bulwark projects the hero's Defense rating into static protection, pre-emptive retaliation, and damage reflection.

basic.description: While a friendly stack Defends, it gains additional physical damage reduction equal to 5% + 0.10% × Hero Defense until its next activation. The first melee attacker is struck pre-emptively for 50% normal damage.

effect.description: While a friendly stack Defends, it gains additional physical damage reduction equal to 5% + 0.10% × Hero Defense until its next activation. The first melee attacker is struck pre-emptively for 50% normal damage.

advanced.description: Bulwark reduction becomes 7.5% + 0.15% × Hero Defense; pre-emptive damage becomes 75%; the stack reflects 25% of actual melee physical damage received after reductions.

effect.description: Bulwark reduction becomes 7.5% + 0.15% × Hero Defense; pre-emptive damage becomes 75%; the stack reflects 25% of actual melee physical damage received after reductions.

expert.description: Bulwark reduction becomes 10% + 0.20% × Hero Defense; pre-emptive damage becomes 100%; melee reflection becomes 50%.

effect.description: Bulwark reduction becomes 10% + 0.20% × Hero Defense; pre-emptive damage becomes 100%; melee reflection becomes 50%.

perks.name: Mireborn
perks.description: On swamp or rough terrain, Bulwark grants an additional 5 percentage points of physical damage reduction.

effect.description: On swamp or rough terrain, Bulwark grants an additional 5 percentage points of physical damage reduction.

perks.name: Thick Hide
perks.description: Bulwark's damage reflection also applies to ranged physical creature damage at half its normal reflection percentage.

effect.description: Bulwark's damage reflection also applies to ranged physical creature damage at half its normal reflection percentage.

perks.name: Bog Ambush
perks.description: Bulwark's pre-emptive attack gains +25 percentage points of normal damage, capped at 100%.

effect.description: Bulwark's pre-emptive attack gains +25 percentage points of normal damage, capped at 100%.

perks.name: Toxic Spines
perks.description: The first melee attacker each round that suffers Bulwark reflection also receives a physical Poison affliction defined by the creature-status system.

effect.description: The first melee attacker each round that suffers Bulwark reflection also receives a physical Poison affliction defined by the creature-status system.

perks.name: Deep Bulwark
perks.description: A stack currently benefiting from Bulwark cannot be forcibly displaced by non-magical effects.

effect.description: A stack currently benefiting from Bulwark cannot be forcibly displaced by non-magical effects.

perks.name: Swamp Renewal
perks.description: At the beginning of the next activation after Defending, a surviving Bulwark stack restores 10% of physical creature damage suffered while Defending; casualties are not restored.

effect.description: At the beginning of the next activation after Defending, a surviving Bulwark stack restores 10% of physical creature damage suffered while Defending; casualties are not restored.

perks.name: Mire Grip
perks.description: A melee attacker that damages a Bulwark stack loses 2 Speed until its next activation.

effect.description: A melee attacker that damages a Bulwark stack loses 2 Speed until its next activation.

perks.name: Shared Cover
perks.description: Adjacent friendly stacks that are also Defending receive half of this hero's Bulwark damage-reduction bonus.

effect.description: Adjacent friendly stacks that are also Defending receive half of this hero's Bulwark damage-reduction bonus.

perks.name: Immovable
perks.description: The first physical creature attack against each Bulwark stack each round deals an additional 25% less final damage.

effect.description: The first physical creature attack against each Bulwark stack each round deals an additional 25% less final damage.

perks.name: Vengeful Mire
perks.description: Increase Bulwark's melee damage-reflection percentage by +25 percentage points, to a maximum of 75%.

effect.description: Increase Bulwark's melee damage-reflection percentage by +25 percentage points, to a maximum of 75%.

new-horizons:elementalRebirth.name: Elemental Rebirth
new-horizons:elementalRebirth.description: Faction-locked Skill. Conflux answers destruction with temporary elemental life. When a normal allied stack is destroyed, Elemental Rebirth summons an Elite Elemental using the lost stack's maximum HP as the scale.

basic.description: When a non-summoned allied stack is destroyed, summon a random Elite Elemental stack at that position with aggregate HP equal to 25% of the destroyed stack's maximum aggregate HP.

effect.description: When a non-summoned allied stack is destroyed, summon a random Elite Elemental stack at that position with aggregate HP equal to 25% of the destroyed stack's maximum aggregate HP.

advanced.description: Reborn Elemental HP becomes 40% of the destroyed stack's maximum aggregate HP.

effect.description: Reborn Elemental HP becomes 40% of the destroyed stack's maximum aggregate HP.

expert.description: Reborn Elemental HP becomes 50% of the destroyed stack's maximum aggregate HP.

effect.description: Reborn Elemental HP becomes 50% of the destroyed stack's maximum aggregate HP.

perks.name: Elemental Attunement
perks.description: At the start of combat, choose one Elite Elemental type to exclude from random Rebirth results.

effect.description: At the start of combat, choose one Elite Elemental type to exclude from random Rebirth results.

perks.name: Swift Rebirth
perks.description: A newly reborn Elemental is inserted into the current Initiative cycle immediately after the current Creature Activation, but cannot receive more than one activation in the round.

effect.description: A newly reborn Elemental is inserted into the current Initiative cycle immediately after the current Creature Activation, but cannot receive more than one activation in the round.

perks.name: Elemental Memory
perks.description: A reborn Elemental inherits the destroyed stack's current positive Morale and Luck modifiers until the end of the round.

effect.description: A reborn Elemental inherits the destroyed stack's current positive Morale and Luck modifiers until the end of the round.

perks.name: Primal Burst
perks.description: When a reborn Elemental appears, adjacent enemies suffer elemental damage equal to 10% of the reborn stack's aggregate HP, divided evenly among them.

effect.description: When a reborn Elemental appears, adjacent enemies suffer elemental damage equal to 10% of the reborn stack's aggregate HP, divided evenly among them.

perks.name: Greater Essence
perks.description: Elemental Rebirth creates an additional +15 percentage points of the destroyed stack's maximum HP.

effect.description: Elemental Rebirth creates an additional +15 percentage points of the destroyed stack's maximum HP.

perks.name: Elemental Ward
perks.description: Reborn Elementals receive 20% magical damage reduction.

effect.description: Reborn Elementals receive 20% magical damage reduction.

perks.name: Adaptive Element
perks.description: Instead of a fully random Elemental, Rebirth selects from Elemental types appropriate to the current battlefield terrain.

effect.description: Instead of a fully random Elemental, Rebirth selects from Elemental types appropriate to the current battlefield terrain.

perks.name: Rebirth Chain
perks.description: Once per combat, when a reborn Elemental is destroyed, summon a second random Elite Elemental with 25% of that reborn stack's original HP. This second Elemental cannot trigger Rebirth.

effect.description: Once per combat, when a reborn Elemental is destroyed, summon a second random Elite Elemental with 25% of that reborn stack's original HP. This second Elemental cannot trigger Rebirth.

perks.name: Perfect Convergence
perks.description: The player chooses the Elite Elemental type for every Rebirth.

effect.description: The player chooses the Elite Elemental type for every Rebirth.

perks.name: Phoenix Spark
perks.description: Once per combat, when a friendly Champion stack is destroyed, the player may summon a temporary Phoenix instead of an Elite Elemental, with aggregate HP equal to 25% of the destroyed Champion stack's maximum aggregate HP.

effect.description: Once per combat, when a friendly Champion stack is destroyed, the player may summon a temporary Phoenix instead of an Elite Elemental, with aggregate HP equal to 25% of the destroyed Champion stack's maximum aggregate HP.
